description_en: Deletes a model operator API key
description_zh: 删除模型算子 API Key
name: DeleteModelOperatorApiKey

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API key to delete. The value must be an integer greater than 0. You can obtain the ID by calling ListModelOperatorApiKeys
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的 API Key ID，必须为大于 0 的整数。可通过 ListModelOperatorApiKeys 获取
parameters.name: api_key_id

ApiKeyId.description_en: The ID of the API key for which the deletion is accepted. The return of this field does not indicate that the underlying cleanup is complete
ApiKeyId.description_zh: 已受理删除的 API Key ID。返回此字段不表示底层清理已经完成

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate and troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次请求
